payload.title: Appearance settings persist per user
payload.description:
As the student, I want my choices remembered.

Feature: Settings persistence
  Scenario: Reload keeps my choices
    Given I chose Warm and Dark
    When I reload the page
    Then the warm dark palette is applied from the first paint with no flash of the default theme
  Scenario: Different users have separate settings
    Given user A chose Warm and user B chose Cool on the same browser
    Then each sees their own theme after signing in
